body.text: Implemented the ForeignTwin rights/robots preflight. foreign observe now records public/denied observe rights, checks robots.txt before a target fetch, emits policy_excluded with fetch_attempted=false for robots/right denials, and fails closed as policy_indeterminate if robots cannot be checked. Target 4xx remains boundary_response. Housing projection documentation and tests preserve that neither exclusion nor denial means absent inventory.

subject: ForeignTwin policy exclusion is now durable and distinct
